messages.content: I need to review the sequence of events for a vulnerability in our system. Can you retrieve the analysis for project with UUID SUPERFANCY, component AB1010CD, and vulnerability ef903ac-893-f00?

function.name: analysis_api_AnalysisApi_retrieve_analysis

project.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the project.

component.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the component within the project.

vulnerability.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the vulnerability associated with the component.
